column1: # Golden graph for tests/fixtures/fullstack_stripes (generated by fullstack_stripes_gen.py).
# Columns: kind, source, target, status. Paths are relative to the fixture root.
# status: now    = present in the graph built by the current code; must stay present.
#         target = an edge the plan adds (W3/W5); tests/witness/test_golden_graph.py
#                  xfails each target kind until it lands, then the xfail must go.
#   * a source without '::' is file-scoped: it matches the file or any node in it;
#   * a target stored unresolved (a bare name) matches the last segment of the row's target;
#     target rows must match exactly, so resolving the name is part of the target;
#   * route:/path  matches an Endpoint node whose extra.route is /path;
#   * table:name   matches a Table node named name.
# Target spellings for kinds that do not exist yet (HANDLES endpoints, USES_STYLE selectors,
# MAPS_TO tables) are proposals; the wave that adds the kind may refine them in the same commit
# that removes the xfail, but not weaken the row into a file-level edge.
